FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 470
Committee: County and Municipal Sponsor: Representative Chris Pringle
Government
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 04/23/2024
House Bill 470 as introduced could increase the obligations of the county commissions by an
undetermined amount dependent on any costs to redraw voting precinct boundaries as required
by this bill.
